import heapq

class MCFGraph:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.pos = []
        self.graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add_edge(self, from_, to, cap, cost):
        m = len(self.pos)
        self.pos.append((from_, len(self.graph[from_])))
        self.graph[from_].append(self._Edge(to, len(self.graph[to]), cap, cost))
        self.graph[to].append(self._Edge(from_, len(self.graph[from_]) - 1, 0, -cost))
        return m

    class Edge:
        def __init__(self, from_, to, cap, flow, cost):
            self.from_ = from_
            self.to = to
            self.cap = cap
            self.flow = flow
            self.cost = cost

    def get_edge(self, i):
        _e = self.graph[self.pos[i][0]][self.pos[i][1]]
        _re = self.graph[_e.to][_e.rev]
        return self.Edge(self.pos[i][0], _e.to, _e.cap + _re.cap, _re.cap, _e.cost)

    def edges(self):
        ret = []
        for i in range(len(self.pos)):
            _e = self.graph[self.pos[i][0]][self.pos[i][1]]
            _re = self.graph[_e.to][_e.rev]
            ret.append(self.Edge(self.pos[i][0], _e.to, _e.cap + _re.cap, _re.cap, _e.cost))
        return ret

    def _dual_ref(self, s, t):
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.n
        self.pv = [-1] * self.n
        self.pe = [-1] * self.n
        self.visited = [False] * self.n
        que = [s]
        self.dist[s] = 0
        while que:
            v = heapq.heappop(que) & 4294967295
            if self.visited[v]:
                continue
            self.visited[v] = True
            if v == t:
                break
            for i in range(len(self.graph[v])):
                e = self.graph[v][i]
                if self.visited[e.to] or e.cap == 0:
                    continue
                reduced_cost = e.cost - self.dual[e.to] + self.dual[v]
                if self.dist[e.to] > self.dist[v] + reduced_cost:
                    self.dist[e.to] = self.dist[v] + reduced_cost
                    self.pv[e.to] = v
                    self.pe[e.to] = i
                    heapq.heappush(que, ((self.dist[e.to] << 32) + e.to))
        if not self.visited[t]:
            return False
        for v in range(self.n):
            if not self.visited[v]:
                continue
            self.dual[v] -= self.dist[t] - self.dist[v]
        return True

    def slope(self, s, t, flow_limit=4294967295):
        self.dual = [0] * self.n
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.n
        self.pv = [-1] * self.n
        self.pe = [-1] * self.n
        self.visited = [False] * self.n
        flow = 0
        total_cost = 0
        prev_reduced_cost = -1
        result = [(flow, total_cost)]
        while flow < flow_limit:
            if not self._dual_ref(s, t):
                break
            c = flow_limit - flow
            v = t
            while v != s:
                c = min(c, self.graph[self.pv[v]][self.pe[v]].cap)
                v = self.pv[v]
            v = t
            while v != s:
                e = self.graph[self.pv[v]][self.pe[v]]
                e.cap -= c
                self.graph[v][e.rev].cap += c
                v = self.pv[v]
            d = -self.dual[s]
            flow += c
            total_cost += c * d

                result.pop()
            result.append((flow, total_cost))
            prev_reduced_cost = d
        return result

    def flow(self, s, t, flow_limit=4294967295):
        return self.slope(s, t, flow_limit)[-1]

    class _Edge:
        def __init__(self, to, rev, cap, cost):
            self.to = to
            self.rev = rev
            self.cap = cap
            self.cost = cost

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cmath>

class MCFGraph {
public:
    MCFGraph(int n) : n(n), dist(n, 0), pv(n, -1), pe(n, -1), visited(n, false), dual(n, 0) {}

    struct Edge {
        int from_;
        int to;
        int cap;
        int flow;
        int cost;
        Edge(int f, int t, int c, int fl, int co) : from_(f), to(t), cap(c), flow(fl), cost(co) {}
    };

    struct _Edge {
        int to;
        int rev;
        int cap;
        int cost;
        _Edge(int t, int r, int c, int co) : to(t), rev(r), cap(c), cost(co) {}
    };

    int add_edge(int from_, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        int m = pos.size();
        pos.emplace_back(from_, graph[from_].size());
        graph[from_].emplace_back(to, graph[to].size(), cap, cost);
        graph[to].emplace_back(from_, graph[from_].size() - 1, 0, -cost);
        return m;
    }

    Edge get_edge(int i) {
        auto& _e = graph[pos[i].first][pos[i].second];
        auto& _re = graph[_e.to][_e.rev];
        return Edge(pos[i].first, _e.to, _e.cap + _re.cap, _re.cap, _e.cost);
    }

    std::vector<Edge> edges() {
        std::vector<Edge> ret;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)pos.size(); ++i) {
            auto& _e = graph[pos[i].first][pos[i].second];
            auto& _re = graph[_e.to][_e.rev];
            ret.emplace_back(pos[i].first, _e.to, _e.cap + _re.cap, _re.cap, _e.cost);
        }
        return ret;
    }

    bool _dual_ref(int s, int t) {
        dist.assign(n, INT_MAX);
        pv.assign(n, -1);
        pe.assign(n, -1);
        visited.assign(n, false);
        std::priority_queue<std::pair<int, int>, std::vector<std::pair<int, int>>, std::greater<std::pair<int, int>>> que;
        dist[s] = 0;
        que.emplace(0, s);
        
        while (!que.empty()) {
            auto [d, v] = que.top();
            que.pop();
            if (visited[v]) continue;
            visited[v] = true;
            if (v == t) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[v].size(); ++i) {
                auto& e = graph[v][i];
                if (visited[e.to] || e.cap == 0) continue;
                int reduced_cost = e.cost - dual[e.to] + dual[v];
                if (dist[e.to] > dist[v] + reduced_cost) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[v] + reduced_cost;
                    pv[e.to] = v;
                    pe[e.to] = i;
                    que.emplace(dist[e.to], e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        if (!visited[t]) return false;
        for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
            if (!visited[v]) continue;
            dual[v] -= dist[t] - dist[v];
        }
        return true;
    }

    std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> slope(int s, int t, int flow_limit = INT_MAX) {
        dual.assign(n, 0);
        dist.assign(n, INT_MAX);
        pv.assign(n, -1);
        pe.assign(n, -1);
        visited.assign(n, false);
        int flow = 0;
        int total_cost = 0;
        int prev_reduced_cost = -1;
        std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> result;
        result.emplace_back(flow, total_cost);
        
        while (flow < flow_limit) {
            if (!_dual_ref(s, t)) break;
            int c = flow_limit - flow;
            int v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                c = std::min(c, graph[pv[v]][pe[v]].cap);
                v = pv[v];
            }
            v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                auto& e = graph[pv[v]][pe[v]];
                e.cap -= c;
                graph[v][e.rev].cap += c;
                v = pv[v];
            }
            int d = -dual[s];
            flow += c;
            total_cost += c * d;
            if (prev_reduced_cost == d) {
                result.pop_back();
            }
            result.emplace_back(flow, total_cost);
            prev_reduced_cost = d;
        }
        return result;
    }

    std::pair<int, int> flow(int s, int t, int flow_limit = INT_MAX) {
        auto res = slope(s, t, flow_limit);
        return res.back();
    }

private:
    int n;
    std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> pos;
    std::vector<std::vector<_Edge>> graph;
    std::vector<int> dist;
    std::vector<int> pv;
    std::vector<int> pe;
    std::vector<bool> visited;
    std::vector<int> dual;
};

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    int a1, a2, a3;
    std::cin >> a1 >> a2 >> a3;
    int b1, b2, b3;
    std::cin >> b1 >> b2 >> b3;

    MCFGraph g(8);
    g.add_edge(0, 1, a1, 0);
    g.add_edge(0, 2, a2, 0);
    g.add_edge(0, 3, a3, 0);
    g.add_edge(4, 7, b1, 0);
    g.add_edge(5, 7, b2, 0);
    g.add_edge(6, 7, b3, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3; ++i) {
        for (int j = 4; j <= 6; ++j) {
            int cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
            g.add_edge(i, j, INT_MAX, cost);
        }
    }

    auto res = g.flow(0, 7);
    int ans1 = res.second;
    int ans2 = std::min(a1, b2) + std::min(a2, b3) + std::min(a3, b1);
    std::cout << ans1 << " " << ans2 << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
